name: Ionosphere Radar Return Benchmark Dataset
description: The Ionosphere dataset consists of 351 radar return signals collected by a phased array antenna system in Goose Bay, Labrador. Each signal pulse is characterized by 34 continuous numerical attributes describing complex electromagnetic autocorrelation values to classify radar returns as good or bad ionospheric structures.

publisher.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository / Johns Hopkins University

size.notes: Comma-delimited records containing 34 real-valued autocorrelation values and 1 binary label.
